appearance_facts.fact: Chart title reads 'Increasing Production at Factory F from 2018 to 2023'.

A single blue line connects six yearly points; the 2018 point is at ~2,800, the 2019 point is the lowest at ~2,400, the 2020 point is the highest at ~2,850, then 2021 ~2,560, 2022 ~2,570, and 2023 ~2,530.
The line is nearly flat with a slight downward drift, ending below the 2018 and 2020 levels but above the 2019 level.
